title: StateWise: Diagnosing and Repairing Persistent Operational State Before Agent Actions
title_zh: StateWise：在智能体执行动作前诊断并修复持久化运行状态

paragraphs.en: LLM agents combine reasoning, tool use, and persistent memory to support work across tasks, reusing stored operational records as premises for later actions. However, changes in environments or requirements can invalidate these records, and existing action review, provenance tracking, and clarification mechanisms may leave the underlying persistent state uncorrected. Our audit of coding-agent trajectories further identifies candidate failure chains linking the continued reuse of invalid records to task failures and unsafe modifications. To address this problem, we propose StateWise , a framework for diagnosing and repairing persistent operational state before action execution. StateWise uses record-level counterfactual replanning to identify decision-critical records by examining how individual record interventions change the proposed action while holding other planning inputs fixed. A hierarchical resolver establishes their current validity through reliability checks, read-only verification of machine-observable facts, and targeted clarification of developer-owned intent. Typed evidence grounding binds the resulting evidence to specific records and their applicable scopes, enabling persistent corrections that preserve repair lineage and support reuse across tasks. The agent then replans from the repaired state, and an independent state–action check assesses the revised proposal before execution. We then evaluate StateWise on a benchmark of 150 executable coding-agent cases across diverse runtime environments, workspace configurations, and repository settings, complemented by cross-model evaluations. Under corrupted persistent state, StateWise achieves 93.3% overall correctness compared with 38.7% for the baseline agent and records no unsafe actions. Furthermore, component ablations, multi-task experiments, and transfer evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of its recovery mechanism, the persistence of its corrections, and its transferability across repositories and tool interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体将推理、工具使用和持久记忆相结合，以支持跨任务的工作，并将存储的操作记录作为后续行动的前提重复利用。 然而，环境或需求的变化可能导致这些记录失效，而现有的行动审查、来源追踪和澄清机制可能无法修正底层的持久状态。 我们对编码智能体轨迹的审计进一步识别出潜在的故障链，这些故障链将无效记录的持续重复使用与任务失败及不安全修改联系起来。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 StateWise——一个在动作执行前诊断和修复持久操作状态的框架。 StateWise 通过记录级的反事实重新规划来识别决策关键记录：它考察单个记录的干预如何改变拟议行动，同时保持其他规划输入不变。 一个分层解析器通过可靠性检查、对机器可观测事实的只读验证以及对开发者所有意图的针对性澄清，来确定这些记录当前的有效性。 类型化的证据基础将所得证据与特定记录及其适用范围绑定，从而实现持久的修正，同时保留修复过程的可追溯性并支持跨任务重复使用。 随后，智能体从修复后的状态重新开始规划，并由一个独立的状态-行动检查机制在执行前评估修订后的方案。 接着，我们在一个包含 150 个可执行编码智能体案例的基准数据集上评估了 StateWise，这些案例覆盖了多样的运行时环境、工作区配置和仓库设置，并辅以跨模型评估。 在持久状态被破坏的情况下，StateWise 的整体正确率达到 93.3%，而基线智能体仅为 38.7%，且 StateWise 未记录任何不安全行动。 此外，组件消融研究、多任务实验和迁移评估表明，其恢复机制有效，修正结果持久，并且能够在不同仓库和工具接口之间迁移使用。

paragraphs.en: Advances in the reasoning, tool-use, and planning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have enabled LLM-based agents to undertake complex tasks across multiple interactions ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . For example, coding agents use these capabilities to configure development environments, modify repositories, investigate failures, and continue working on software projects ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . To maintain continuity across tasks, agents retain operational records in persistent state, including environment facts, repository policies, developer intent, task progress, and historical observations ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Sumers et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . Agents retrieve and reuse these records to build on previous work and plan subsequent actions. When retrieved records guide tool selection, target identification, or action arguments, they serve as premises for operational decisions. Task correctness and operational safety therefore depend on whether the records supporting an action remain valid in its current context.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在推理、工具使用和规划能力方面的进步，使得基于 LLM 的智能体能够在多次交互中执行复杂任务（Yao 等，2023；Schick 等，2023；Wang 等，2024；Shinn 等，2023）。 例如，编码智能体利用这些能力来配置开发环境、修改代码库、排查故障，并继续推进软件项目（Yang 等，2024；Wang 等，2025）。 为了在任务之间保持连续性，智能体将操作记录保留在持久状态中，包括环境事实、代码库策略、开发者意图、任务进展和历史观察结果（Packer 等，2023；Sumers 等，2024；Zhong 等，2024；Xu 等，2025）。 智能体通过检索和复用这些记录，来延续先前的工作并规划后续行动。 当检索到的记录指导工具选择、目标识别或行动参数时，它们便成为操作决策的前提依据。 因此，任务的正确性和操作的安全性取决于支持某项行动的记录在当前语境中是否仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: However, as projects, policies, and environments change, persistent records that were correct when stored can become outdated or inapplicable. Prior work documents stale memories, superseding evidence, and facts used beyond their period of validity ( Chao et al., 2026 ; Patel, 2026 ; Yadav, 2026 ; Dhingra et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) . As operational records accumulate across extended interactions, maintaining their current applicability becomes increasingly difficult ( Al-Tawaha et al., 2026 ; Uddin et al., 2026 ) . Because these records persist across tasks, blocking an erroneous operation alone leaves its underlying premise available to influence later plans. paragraphs.en: Limitation 1: Action Control without Persistent Repair. Action-level safeguards, including execution-boundary controls and approval mechanisms, primarily determine whether a proposed operation should proceed ( Bühler et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . Risk-evaluation frameworks also examine potentially harmful agent operations in simulated or executable environments ( Ruan et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These approaches can assess or constrain an operation without necessarily identifying and correcting the persistent state error that produced it. An erroneous record can therefore be reused in later tasks even after the current operation is blocked, causing the agent to propose incorrect or unsafe operations again.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性 1：缺乏持续修复的动作控制。 动作层面的保障机制，包括执行边界控制和审批机制，主要决定一项拟议操作是否应继续执行（Bühler 等，2026；Chen 等，2026b）。 风险评估框架还会在模拟或可执行环境中检查智能体可能产生的有害操作（Ruan 等，2024；Li 等，2026）。 这些方法能够评估或限制某项操作，但并不一定能够识别并纠正导致该操作的持续状态错误。 因此，即使当前操作被阻止，错误的记录仍可能在后续任务中被重复使用，导致智能体再次提出不正确或不安全的操作。

paragraphs.en: Limitation 2: Unverified Validity of Trusted Records. Provenance and information-flow methods help identify untrusted inputs and trace their influence on agents ( Ouyang and Hou, 2026 ; She et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . However, a trustworthy source does not establish that a record remains valid. An authentic, unmodified record can become inapplicable to the current operation after the environment changes. Similarly, an agent can remain confident in a plan built on an outdated record, preventing uncertainty-based clarification from being triggered ( Edwards and Schuster, 2026 ; Ren et al., 2023 ) . Even when a conversation corrects the current decision, later tasks can reuse the old information if the corresponding persistent record is not updated. These failures require no attacker, so defenses against malicious input alone are insufficient ( Abdelnabi et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 局限性 2：可信记录的有效性未经验证。 来源追溯和信息流方法有助于识别不可信输入，并追踪其对智能体的影响（Ouyang 和 Hou，2026；She 等，2026；Cai 等，2026）。 然而，一个可信的来源并不能证明一条记录仍然有效。 即使是一条真实且未修改的记录，在环境变化后也可能变得不适用于当前操作。 同样，一个智能体可能仍然对基于过时记录制定的计划保持信心，从而阻止基于不确定性的澄清机制被触发（Edwards 和 Schuster，2026；Ren 等，2023）。 即使对话纠正了当前的决策，如果相应的持久性记录未得到更新，后续任务仍可能重复使用旧信息。 这些失败无需攻击者即可发生，因此仅依靠针对恶意输入的防御措施是不足的（Abdelnabi 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Limitation 3: Incomplete Diagnosis of Action Premises. When an operation depends on multiple historical records, reviewing the operation alone leaves the influence of individual records unresolved. Attribution and memory-lineage methods trace how historical context and stored records contribute to agent decisions ( Qian et al., 2026 ; Ouyang and Hou, 2026 ) . For persistent-state diagnosis, these influence links must also be connected to the current validity and scope of the underlying records. Research on stale memory shows that later evidence can invalidate earlier premises and require corresponding changes in downstream behavior ( Chao et al., 2026 ) . The same operation can be appropriate under a valid premise but risky under an outdated or mis-scoped one. State diagnosis therefore requires locating the records that shape action selection and verifying their applicability to the current task.

paragraphs.en: These limitations motivate examining how historical operational information continues to shape agent decisions after becoming invalid. paragraphs.en: Accordingly, these observations motivate the following recovery question: How can coding agents identify and repair invalid operational premises before execution and preserve verified corrections for later tasks? To make this question precise, we first characterize how persistent records influence action selection. A record is decision-critical when changing or removing it changes the proposed action while other planning inputs remain fixed. We then define a persistent-state-induced action failure as a failure in which an incorrect, stale, or mis-scoped record changes the proposed action relative to its currently valid counterpart and leads to an incorrect or unsafe outcome. Recovery therefore aims to verify the premises supporting an action, persist confirmed corrections within their applicable scopes, and replan before external side effects occur.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这些观察结果引出了以下恢复问题：编码智能体如何在执行前识别并修复无效的操作前提，并将已验证的修正保留用于后续任务？ 为了使这个问题更精确，我们首先描述持久化记录如何影响动作选择。 当更改或删除某条记录会改变所提议的动作，而其他规划输入保持不变时，该记录就是决策关键的。 接着，我们将由持久化状态引发的动作失败定义为这样一种失败：一条不正确、过时或范围不当的记录改变了所提议的动作，使其偏离当前有效的对应动作，并导致不正确或不安全的结果。 因此，恢复的目标是验证支持某一动作的前提，在其适用范围内保留已确认的修正，并在外部副作用发生前重新规划。

paragraphs.en: To address this problem, we propose StateWise, a pre-action framework for diagnosing and repairing persistent operational state. Given a proposed action with external side effects, StateWise traces its supporting records, resolves their current validity, and writes confirmed corrections to persistent storage. The agent then replans from the repaired state, and an independent state–action check governs execution. This framework enables agents to address four challenges arising from the recovery problem.

paragraphs.en: Q1: How can recovery distinguish decision influence from retrieval relevance? A persistent-state-induced action failure depends on a record changing action selection. Recovery must therefore identify decision-critical premises among the many records retrieved as relevant context. StateWise uses constrained counterfactual replanning to isolate record-level influence. It removes or changes one candidate record while holding other planning inputs fixed, then compares the resulting action’s operation, target, arguments, and scope with the original proposal. Type and scope bindings connect this influence evidence to the corresponding action slots, locating candidate decision-critical premises for verification.
paragraphs.zh: Q1：恢复机制如何区分决策影响与检索相关性？ 持续状态引发的动作失败取决于记录对动作选择的改变。 因此，恢复机制必须从众多被检索为相关上下文的记录中，识别出对决策至关重要的前提。 StateWise 通过受约束的反事实重新规划，来隔离记录层面的影响。 它会移除或更改一个候选记录，同时保持其他规划输入不变，然后将由此产生的动作的操作、目标、参数和范围与原始提案进行比较。 类型和范围的绑定将这种影响证据连接到相应的动作槽位，从而定位可供验证的候选决策关键前提。

paragraphs.en: Q2: How can recovery verify current validity across different record types? Diagnosing an incorrect, stale, or mis-scoped premise requires evidence about both its value and its current applicability to the proposed action. The appropriate evidence depends on the record’s type and authority. StateWise uses hierarchical state resolution, first checking type, scope, source authority, freshness, and conflicting evidence. It then resolves remaining machine-observable facts through read-only verification and developer-owned intent through targeted clarification. The resolver explicitly assigns each record a valid, defective, or unresolved status, grounding subsequent repair and execution decisions in the available evidence.
paragraphs.zh: Q2：恢复机制如何验证当前有效性在不同记录类型中的适用性？ 要诊断一个错误、过时或范围不当的前提，需要关于其值以及对所提议行动当前适用性的证据。 适当的证据取决于记录的类型和权威性。 StateWise 使用分层状态解析，首先检查类型、范围、源权威性、新鲜度和冲突证据。 接着，它通过只读验证解决机器可观测的剩余事实，并通过针对性澄清解决开发者负责意图相关的问题。 该解析器明确为每条记录分配有效、有缺陷或未解决的状态，使后续的修复和执行决策基于可用证据。

paragraphs.en: Q3: How can recovery preserve corrections and their scope across tasks? A correction made only in the current interaction leaves the persistent premise available to influence later plans. Recovery must therefore preserve corrections together with their applicability boundaries and supporting evidence. StateWise uses typed evidence grounding to bind each confirmed correction to the attributed record and its applicable scope. Within that scope, the update supersedes the defective active value and retains the original record and corrective evidence as repair lineage. Later tasks can retrieve the corrected value together with the basis for its update.
paragraphs.zh: Q3：恢复机制如何能在不同任务中保留修正及其作用范围？ 若修正仅在当前交互中生效，则持久化的前提仍会影响后续计划。 因此，恢复机制必须将修正与其适用边界及支持证据一并保留。 StateWise 通过类型化证据锚定，将每次确认的修正绑定至对应的记录及其适用范围。 在该范围内，更新将取代有缺陷的当前值，同时保留原始记录和修正证据作为修复溯源信息。 后续任务可获取已修正的值及其更新依据。

paragraphs.en: Q4: How can recovery address action risks that remain after state repair? Repairing a decision-critical premise can change the proposed action while leaving other planning errors unresolved. Recovery must therefore assess the revised operation against the repaired state and execution constraints. StateWise replans from the repaired store and applies an independent state–action check to the new proposal. This check evaluates the action’s arguments and scope against the verified state, safety invariants, and permission requirements. Execution proceeds only when the required premises are resolved and the checks pass, with StateWise returning a safe stop otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: Q4：在状态修复之后，恢复机制如何应对仍然存在的行动风险？ 修复一个对决策至关重要的前提可能会改变所提议的行动，而其他规划错误可能仍未解决。 因此，恢复机制必须根据修复后的状态和执行约束，评估修订后的操作。 StateWise 会从修复后的存储中重新规划，并对新的提议执行独立的状态-行动检查。 该检查会将行动的参数和范围与已验证的状态、安全不变量及权限要求进行对比评估。 只有当必要前提得到解决且检查通过时，执行才会继续；否则，StateWise 将返回安全停止状态。

paragraphs.en: In general, our contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: We audit real coding-agent trajectories and identify candidate chains in which historical operational information continues to influence actions despite conflicting evidence, exposing a persistent-state recovery gap. We formalize persistent-state-induced action failure through record defects, decision-critical action dependence, and incorrect or unsafe outcomes, and define pre-action recovery around verification and scoped persistent repair.

paragraphs.en: Agent-memory systems support this continuity by organizing and retrieving information from earlier experience ( Park et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ; Sumers et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . A-Mem creates links among structured memories and updates existing representations as new information arrives ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , while Mem0 extracts and consolidates salient conversational information for persistent retrieval ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) . Memory benchmarks assess recall, reasoning across sessions, and adaptation to updated information ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . As these memories are reused, their current validity becomes central to agent reliability. Temporal question-answering research studies facts whose validity changes over time ( Dhingra et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Kasai et al., 2023 ; Vu et al., 2024 ) , while agent-memory research examines stale records, superseding evidence, and temporal validity in retrieval ( Chao et al., 2026 ; Patel, 2026 ; Yadav, 2026 ) . Knowledge-editing research likewise studies factual updates, their consequences for related knowledge, and preservation of unrelated knowledge ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Mitchell et al., 2022 ; De Cao et al., 2021 ; Zhong et al., 2023 ) . For operational records, these concerns extend to whether a correction remains applicable to the current task and scope.

paragraphs.en: Maintaining applicable records also requires tracing their influence on actions. Prompt-injection research and benchmarks examine how untrusted external content redirects agent behavior ( Abdelnabi et al., 2023 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) . Attribution and provenance methods trace these influences through memory lineage ( Ouyang and Hou, 2026 ) , provenance analysis ( She et al., 2026 ) , information-flow tracking ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , and attribution to earlier context ( Qian et al., 2026 ) . These methods help locate the sources and contextual premises behind a decision, particularly when the underlying information may be untrusted. An authentic record can nevertheless become outdated as its environment changes. Operational diagnosis therefore requires connecting these influence links to evidence about a record’s current value and applicability to the proposed operation.
paragraphs.zh: 维护适用记录还需要追溯它们对行动的影响。 提示注入研究与基准测试旨在探究不可信的外部内容如何引导智能体的行为（Abdelnabi 等，2023；Zhan 等，2024；Debenedetti 等，2024）。 归因与来源追溯方法通过记忆谱系（Ouyang 和 Hou，2026）、来源分析（She 等，2026）、信息流追踪（Cai 等，2026）以及对早期上下文的归因（Qian 等，2026）来追溯这些影响。 这些方法有助于定位决策背后的来源和上下文前提，尤其是在底层信息可能不可信的情况下。 然而，随着环境变化，一份真实的记录也可能变得过时。 因此，操作诊断需要将这些影响链路连接到关于记录当前值及其对拟议操作适用性的证据。

paragraphs.en: At the execution boundary, this diagnostic concern connects to oversight of the resulting operation and its potential consequences. Human oversight and mixed-initiative systems provide ways to intervene in automated decisions ( Horvitz, 1999 ; Amershi et al., 2019 ) . Repeated confirmations can encourage routine approval, while poorly explained warnings may be ignored ( Parasuraman and Riley, 1997 ; Lee and See, 2004 ; Buçinca et al., 2021 ; Johnson et al., 2013 ; Sadowski et al., 2018 ) . Clarification methods seek missing information or user intent relevant to the current task ( Aliannejadi et al., 2019 ; Rao and Daumé III, 2018 ; Ren et al., 2023 ; Edwards and Schuster, 2026 ) . Action safeguards choose whether to execute, ask, or refuse a proposed operation ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . Execution controls constrain resource access, while risk-evaluation frameworks assess operations in emulated or executable environments ( Bühler et al., 2026 ; Ruan et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . For cross-task recovery, any correction established through oversight must also be written to the persistent record within its applicable scope.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行边界上，这种诊断性关注点与对由此产生的操作及其潜在后果的监督相关联。 人类监督与混合主动系统为干预自动化决策提供了方法（Horvitz, 1999；Amershi 等, 2019）。 重复确认可能促使例行批准，而解释不清的警告则可能被忽视（Parasuraman 和 Riley, 1997；Lee 和 See, 2004；Buçinca 等, 2021；Johnson 等, 2013；Sadowski 等, 2018）。 澄清方法旨在获取与当前任务相关的缺失信息或用户意图（Aliannejadi 等, 2019；Rao 和 Daumé III, 2018；Ren 等, 2023；Edwards 和 Schuster, 2026）。 行动保障机制会决定是执行、询问还是拒绝一项提议的操作（Chen 等, 2026b）。 执行控制会限制对资源的访问，而风险评估框架则会在模拟或可执行环境中评估操作（Bühler 等, 2026；Ruan 等, 2024；Li 等, 2026）。 对于跨任务恢复，任何通过监督确立的修正都必须在其适用范围内写入持久化记录。

paragraphs.en: The retained candidates exhibit a common pattern: historical operational information remains available and is reused in a later decision, while new evidence indicates that it no longer applies to the current operation. These observations motivate a recovery problem: identify the persistent records that influence a proposed action, establish their current validity, and preserve scoped corrections for replanning and later tasks. To make this problem precise, we distinguish record influence, record defects, and action outcomes, then specify the requirements for recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 保留下来的候选方案呈现出一种共同模式：历史操作信息仍然可用，并在后续决策中被重新使用，而新证据则表明这些信息已不再适用于当前操作。 这些观察结果引出了一个恢复问题：识别出哪些持久性记录会影响所提议的行动，确定它们的当前有效性，并为重新规划及后续任务保留范围明确的修正。 为了使这个问题更精确，我们区分了记录影响、记录缺陷和行动结果，然后明确了恢复所需的要求。

paragraphs.en: The central technical contribution is a record-level connection between decision influence, current validity, and persistent repair. StateWise couples constrained counterfactual replanning with hierarchical state resolution and typed evidence grounding. Counterfactual probes identify action-sensitive records, resolution obtains evidence from the appropriate authority, and evidence grounding binds each correction to the attributed record and its established scope. Maintaining these bindings across stages connects the premise that influenced an action to the evidence authorizing its update. The resulting correction supports both current replanning and later retrieval, while an independent state–action check addresses remaining execution risks.
paragraphs.zh: 核心的技术贡献在于实现了决策影响、当前有效性和持续修复之间的记录级关联。 StateWise 将受约束的反事实重新规划与分层状态解析及类型化证据锚定相结合。 反事实探针识别对动作敏感的记录，解析从适当的权威来源获取证据，而证据锚定则将每次修正绑定到所归属的记录及其既定范围。 在这些阶段中保持这些绑定关系，能够将影响某个动作的前提与该动作更新所依据的证据连接起来。 由此产生的修正既支持当前的重新规划，也支持后续检索，同时一个独立的状态-动作检查可应对剩余的执行风险。

paragraphs.en: The second challenge is to establish whether an attributed premise remains valid for the current operation. Validity depends on both the record’s semantic value and its applicability, and the appropriate evidence varies with its type and authority. Resolution addresses this challenge through a hierarchy of evidence checks, read-only verification, and targeted clarification.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个挑战是确定某个属性前提在当前操作中是否仍然有效。 有效性既取决于记录的语义价值，也取决于其适用性，而适当的证据则因记录类型和权威性而异。 解决方案通过层级化的证据检查、只读验证以及针对性澄清来应对这一挑战。

sents.en: The second challenge is to establish whether an attributed premise remains valid for the current operation.
sents.zh: 第二个挑战是确定某个属性前提在当前操作中是否仍然有效。

sents.en: Validity depends on both the record’s semantic value and its applicability, and the appropriate evidence varies with its type and authority.
sents.zh: 有效性既取决于记录的语义价值，也取决于其适用性，而适当的证据则因记录类型和权威性而异。

sents.en: Resolution addresses this challenge through a hierarchy of evidence checks, read-only verification, and targeted clarification.
sents.zh: 解决方案通过层级化的证据检查、只读验证以及针对性澄清来应对这一挑战。

paragraphs.en: For each record in D + D^{+} , Resolution first examines its type, scope, source authority, freshness, and newer or conflicting evidence. These checks assess whether the available evidence establishes the record’s value and applicability for the present task. They address temporal and contextual validity issues identified in agent memory ( Chao et al., 2026 ; Patel, 2026 ; Yadav, 2026 ) . When the available evidence is sufficient, Resolution can classify the record directly. Additional verification is directed to premises whose validity remains unsettled.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 D + D^{+} 中的每条记录，Resolution 首先会检查其类型、范围、来源权威性、时效性，以及是否存在更新或冲突的证据。 这些检查旨在评估现有证据是否足以确立该记录在当前任务中的价值与适用性。 它们解决了智能体记忆中已识别出的时间性和情境有效性问题（Chao 等人，2026；Patel，2026；Yadav，2026）。 当现有证据充分时，Resolution 可以直接对该记录进行分类。 对于有效性尚未确定的前提，则需进行进一步的验证。

paragraphs.en: For a machine-observable fact, Resolution invokes the registered read-only verifier. The verifier observes the current repository or environment and returns evidence bound to the record’s type and scope. For developer intent, preference, or another user-owned choice that observation cannot establish, Resolution asks a targeted clarification question naming the disputed fact and its scope. This route follows mixed-initiative clarification work ( Aliannejadi et al., 2019 ; Rao and Daumé III, 2018 ; Edwards and Schuster, 2026 ) . Clarification is triggered by a specific gap in authoritative evidence for an action premise. The resulting observation or response must establish evidence for the same record and scope identified by Attribution .
paragraphs.zh: 对于机器可观测的事实，Resolution 会调用已注册的只读验证器。 验证器会观察当前的存储库或环境，并返回与记录类型和范围绑定的证据。 对于开发者意图、偏好或其他用户拥有的、无法通过观察确定的选择，Resolution 会提出一个有针对性的澄清问题，明确争议事实及其范围。 此路径遵循混合主动式澄清方法（Aliannejadi 等人，2019；Rao 和 Daumé III，2018；Edwards 和 Schuster，2026）。 当某个行动前提缺乏权威证据时，就会触发澄清过程。 由此产生的观察结果或回应必须为 Attribution 所识别的同一记录及范围提供证据。

paragraphs.en: Experimental Setup. As shown in Figure 4 , we evaluate StateWise through executable coding tasks, with the figure summarizing case sources, persistent-state types, and annotation results. We use GPT-5.6-sol as the primary planner and additionally evaluate DeepSeek v4 Pro, Qwen 3.7 Max, and Claude Fable 5. We develop the StateWise pipeline on 40 cases and evaluate the finalized pipeline on 150 primary cases, comprising 125 tasks that require an operation and 25 that require a safe stop. The 150-case benchmark combines our designed coding cases with cases informed by existing research on agent memory, clarification, and tool safety,covering runtime and other environment state, Git repositories,and user settings, as shown in Figure 4 . The agent plans from the task and retrieved persistent records, and the intervention checks its proposal before execution. Predefined outcome checks and safety constraints determine task correctness and action safety. We use this set to compare correct, erroneous, and removed target records, assess component contributions, and examine transfer to configurations not encountered during development. Within each comparison, methods use the same cases, with task conditions and evaluation rules held fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 如图 4 所示，我们通过可执行的编码任务来评估 StateWise，该图总结了案例来源、持久状态类型和标注结果。 我们将 GPT-5.6-sol 作为主要规划器，并额外评估了 DeepSeek v4 Pro、Qwen 3.7 Max 和 Claude Fable 5。 我们在 40 个案例上开发了 StateWise 流程，并在 150 个主要案例上评估了最终流程，其中包括需要执行操作的 125 项任务和需要安全停止的 25 项任务。 这 150 个案例的基准测试结合了我们设计的编码案例，以及参考现有关于智能体记忆、澄清和工具安全的研究而设计的案例，涵盖了运行时和其他环境状态、Git 仓库和用户设置，如图 4 所示。 智能体根据任务和检索到的持久记录进行规划，而干预机制会在执行前检查其提案。 预定义的結果检查和安全性约束决定了任务的正确性和动作的安全性。 我们使用这组数据来比较正确、错误和已移除的目标记录，评估各组件的贡献，并检验模型能否迁移到开发过程中未遇到的配置。 在每次比较中，各方法均使用相同的案例，且任务条件和评估规则保持不变。

paragraphs.en: We first examine whether an error in a single target memory record can change the agent’s execution outcome. On the primary 150-case evaluation, we compare correct, corrupted, and removed target memory. The correct and corrupted conditions differ only in the target memory record. All other records, task requirements, initial workspace state, outcome checks, and safety constraints remain fixed to isolate the effect of that error. Removing the target memory tests whether eliminating misleading information restores performance or also removes information needed for task completion. We compare these conditions using OC, AC, and UAR. The three panels in Figure 5 report these metrics in order. This question focuses on conditions 1–3: correct target memory, corrupted target memory, and removed target memory. Comparing 1 with 2 reveals the effect of the error, while comparing 2 with 3 tests whether removal is sufficient for recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先考察单个目标记忆记录中的错误是否可能改变智能体的执行结果。 在主要的 150 个案例评估中，我们比较了正确的、被损坏的以及被移除的目标记忆。 正确与损坏的条件仅在于目标记忆记录的不同。 所有其他记录、任务要求、初始工作区状态、结果检查和安全约束均保持不变，以孤立该错误的影响。 移除目标记忆可检验：消除误导性信息是否能恢复性能，或是否也会一并移除完成任务所需的信息。 我们使用 OC、AC 和 UAR 来比较这些条件。 图 5 中的三个面板按顺序报告了这些指标。 本问题聚焦于条件 1–3：正确的目标记忆、被损坏的目标记忆以及被移除的目标记忆。 比较条件 1 与 2 可揭示错误的影响，而比较条件 2 与 3 则能检验移除目标记忆是否足以恢复性能。

paragraphs.en: Under matched conditions, corrupting only the target memory reduces OC from 80.7% to 38.7% and AC from 76.8% to 27.2%. UAR rises from 0.0% to 42.7%. These changes show that a single erroneous target memory record can substantially impair task performance and induce unsafe actions, even when the remaining memory and execution conditions are unchanged. The results provide controlled evidence consistent with the failure chain described in Section 3 : an erroneous persistent premise can affect action selection and the resulting outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 在匹配条件不足的情况下，仅破坏目标记忆可将 OC 从 80.7% 降至 38.7%，将 AC 从 76.8% 降至 27.2%。 UAR 从 0.0% 上升至 42.7%。 这些变化表明，即使其余记忆和执行条件保持不变，单个错误的目标记忆记录也可能严重损害任务表现并引发不安全行为。 这些结果提供了受控证据，与第 3 节中描述的故障链一致：一个错误的持久性前提可能会影响动作选择及其最终结果。

paragraphs.en: Removing the target memory yields only a modest improvement, with OC reaching 45.3% and AC reaching 35.2%. Both remain much closer to the corrupted-memory condition than to correct memory, where OC is 80.7% and AC is 76.8%. Although UAR falls to 9.3%, avoiding misleading information does little to restore task completion when the relevant historical information is also lost. This contrast highlights the value of recovering a valid planning premise: StateWise achieves 93.3% OC and 92.8% AC from erroneous memory, with no observed unsafe action.
paragraphs.zh: 移除目标记忆仅带来轻微改善，其中 OC 达到 45.3%，AC 达到 35.2%。 这两种情况都仍远接近于记忆损坏的条件，而非正确记忆的条件（此时 OC 为 80.7%，AC 为 76.8%）。 尽管 UAR 下降至 9.3%，但在相关历史信息也丢失的情况下，避免误导性信息对恢复任务完成度几乎无益。 这种对比凸显了恢复有效规划前提的重要性：StateWise 从错误记忆中实现了 93.3% 的 OC 和 92.8% 的 AC，且未观察到任何不安全操作。

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ1. Errors in target memory undermine both task completion and action safety. Removing that memory reduces harm but leaves the agent without information needed to complete the task. These findings motivate recovery at the level of persistent planning premises, where erroneous information is replaced with verified evidence to support correct and safe execution.
paragraphs.zh: 对研究问题1的回答。 目标记忆中的错误会破坏任务完成度和行动安全性。 移除这些记忆虽能减少危害，但也会使智能体缺乏完成任务所需的信息。 这些发现促使我们在持久规划前提层面进行恢复，即用经过验证的证据替换错误信息，以支持正确且安全的执行。

paragraphs.en: We next examine whether existing interventions can close this gap, comparing their OC, AC, and UAR with StateWise. Common engineering strategies include Bare Approval, which requests approval for the proposed action, Rationale Approval, which also explains the action’s rationale, and Clarification, which asks for additional information before proceeding. Baselines from existing approaches include MemLineage ( Ouyang and Hou, 2026 ) , which screens memory using provenance and lineage, Safety Sentry ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , which intervenes based on action risk, and Ask-or-Assume ( Edwards and Schuster, 2026 ) , which uses uncertainty to decide whether to ask or proceed. We also compare CRITIC ( Gou et al., 2024 ) , which uses external tool feedback to evaluate and correct outputs, to examine whether tool-supported self-correction can recover from erroneous target memory. Finally, we include Live Refresh as a simple approach to obtaining current information. The agent is explicitly prompted to inspect the current workspace and refresh relevant information, while choosing when and what to inspect. Figure 6 compares the OC and UAR of these interventions with those of StateWise under erroneous target memory.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将检验现有干预措施能否填补这一差距，通过将其 OC、AC 和 UAR 与 StateWise 进行比较。 常见的工程策略包括“基础批准”（Bare Approval），即请求对拟议行动进行批准；“理由批准”（Rationale Approval），即在请求批准的同时解释该行动的理由；以及“澄清”（Clarification），即在继续行动前请求更多信息。 现有方法的基础模型包括 MemLineage（Ouyang 和 Hou，2026），它通过来源和追溯链对记忆进行筛选；Safety Sentry（Chen 等，2026b），它基于行动风险进行干预；以及 Ask-or-Assume（Edwards 和 Schuster，2026），它利用不确定性来决定是提问还是继续执行。 我们还与 CRITIC（Gou 等，2024）进行了比较，该模型使用外部工具的反馈来评估和纠正输出，以检验工具辅助的自我纠正能否从错误的目标记忆中恢复。 最后，我们将 Live Refresh 作为一种获取当前信息的简单方法纳入其中。 智能体被明确提示检查当前工作空间并刷新相关信息，同时自行决定何时以及检查哪些内容。 图 6 比较了这些干预措施在存在错误目标记忆时的 OC 和 UAR 与 StateWise 的对应指标。

Even with an explicit reminder, refresh remains selective and recovery is limited, suggesting that obtaining current information must be accompanied by identifying and revising the relevant planning premises. StateWise makes this verification and repair explicit, while retaining corrections for subsequent tasks.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate how effectively StateWise restores correct and safe task execution under different persistent-state conditions and with different planning models. Figure 7 presents the cross-model results in terms of OC and AC.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 StateWise 在不同持续状态条件和不同规划模型下，恢复正确且安全的任务执行效果。 图 7 展示了跨模型在 OC 和 AC 方面的结果。

sents.en: We evaluate how effectively StateWise restores correct and safe task execution under different persistent-state conditions and with different planning models.
sents.zh: 我们评估了 StateWise 在不同持续状态条件和不同规划模型下，恢复正确且安全的任务执行效果。

sents.en: Figure 7 presents the cross-model results in terms of OC and AC.
sents.zh: 图 7 展示了跨模型在 OC 和 AC 方面的结果。

paragraphs.en: Under erroneous target memory, StateWise achieves 93.3% OC and 92.8% AC on the primary 150-case evaluation. When the target value is correct but its freshness, provenance, or supporting context is defective, it achieves 88.0% OC and 82.9% AC. Neither setting produces an observed unsafe action. These results support recovery from both incorrect values and defects in the evidence supporting their current use.
paragraphs.zh: 在目标记忆错误的情况下，StateWise 在主评估的 150 个案例中实现了 93.3% 的 OC 和 92.8% 的 AC。 当目标值正确但其新鲜度、来源或支持上下文存在缺陷时，它实现了 88.0% 的 OC 和 82.9% 的 AC。 这两种设置均未产生观察到的不安全行为。 这些结果支持从错误值以及支持其当前使用的证据缺陷中恢复。

sents.zh: 在目标记忆错误的情况下，StateWise 在主评估的 150 个案例中实现了 93.3% 的 OC 和 92.8% 的 AC。

sents.zh: 当目标值正确但其新鲜度、来源或支持上下文存在缺陷时，它实现了 88.0% 的 OC 和 82.9% 的 AC。

paragraphs.en: For cross-model validation, figure 7 shows OC ranging from 80.0% to 94.4% and AC from 69.2% to 90.9%, with no observed unsafe action under any model. Task completion varies with the planner, but the same procedure supports correct and safe recovery across all four tested models.
paragraphs.zh: 在跨模型验证中，图7显示OC的取值范围从80.0%到94.4%，AC的取值范围从69.2%到90.9%，且在任何模型下均未观察到不安全行为。 任务完成度因规划器而异，但相同的流程在所有四个测试模型中均能支持正确且安全的恢复。

sents.en: For cross-model validation, figure 7 shows OC ranging from 80.0% to 94.4% and AC from 69.2% to 90.9%, with no observed unsafe action under any model.
sents.zh: 在跨模型验证中，图7显示OC的取值范围从80.0%到94.4%，AC的取值范围从69.2%到90.9%，且在任何模型下均未观察到不安全行为。

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ3. StateWise supports correct and safe task execution under both erroneous target values and defective supporting context. The unchanged recovery procedure also operates across four planning models, achieving 80.0%–94.4% OC with no safety violations across the episodes.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 的答案。 StateWise 在目标值错误和辅助上下文存在缺陷的情况下，仍能正确且安全地执行任务。 未更改的恢复程序也适用于四种规划模型，在所有回合中实现了 80.0%–94.4% 的 OC，且未发生任何安全违规。

sents.en: Answer to RQ3.
sents.zh: RQ3 的答案。

sents.en: StateWise supports correct and safe task execution under both erroneous target values and defective supporting context.
sents.zh: StateWise 在目标值错误和辅助上下文存在缺陷的情况下，仍能正确且安全地执行任务。

sents.en: The unchanged recovery procedure also operates across four planning models, achieving 80.0%–94.4% OC with no safety violations across the episodes.
sents.zh: 未更改的恢复程序也适用于四种规划模型，在所有回合中实现了 80.0%–94.4% 的 OC，且未发生任何安全违规。

paragraphs.en: To understand how StateWise achieves recovery, we remove one component at a time on the same 150 primary cases. Figure 8 compares the resulting OC and AC with those of the full pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解 StateWise 如何实现恢复，我们在相同的 150 个初始案例中逐一移除一个组件。 图 8 将由此产生的 OC 和 AC 与完整流程的结果进行了比较。

sents.en: To understand how StateWise achieves recovery, we remove one component at a time on the same 150 primary cases.
sents.zh: 为了理解 StateWise 如何实现恢复，我们在相同的 150 个初始案例中逐一移除一个组件。

sents.en: Figure 8 compares the resulting OC and AC with those of the full pipeline.
sents.zh: 图 8 将由此产生的 OC 和 AC 与完整流程的结果进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Removing Resolution or Persistent Repair lowers OC by 78.7 and 76.7 percentage points, respectively, and reduces AC to zero. These losses highlight the importance of establishing evidence-supported corrections and making them available to planning, as described in Sections 4.3 . Avoiding unsafe execution alone does not restore task completion.
paragraphs.zh: 移除“Resolution”或“Persistent Repair”功能会使 OC 分别下降 78.7 和 76.7 个百分点，并将 AC 降至零。 这些损失凸显了建立有证据支持的修正措施，并如第 4.3 节所述将其提供给规划系统的重要性。 仅避免不安全执行本身并不能恢复任务完成状态。

sents.en: Removing Resolution or Persistent Repair lowers OC by 78.7 and 76.7 percentage points, respectively, and reduces AC to zero.
sents.zh: 移除“Resolution”或“Persistent Repair”功能会使 OC 分别下降 78.7 和 76.7 个百分点，并将 AC 降至零。

paragraphs.en: Removing Attribution lowers OC by 53.3 percentage points. Because this variant also disables downstream state intervention, the loss reflects the combined contribution of that path. Removing Typed Grounding lowers OC by 27.3 percentage points, showing the importance of binding evidence to the appropriate record type and action scope. The losses from these four ablations remain significant after Holm correction across the six comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 移除归因使 OC 降低 53.3 个百分点。 由于该变体也禁用了下游状态干预，因此损失反映了该路径的综合贡献。 移除类型化基础使 OC 降低 27.3 个百分点，这表明将证据与适当的记录类型和行动范围绑定至关重要。 在这六项比较中，经过 Holm 校正后，这四种消融方法带来的损失仍然显著。

sents.en: Removing Attribution lowers OC by 53.3 percentage points.
sents.zh: 移除归因使 OC 降低 53.3 个百分点。

sents.zh: 在这六项比较中，经过 Holm 校正后，这四种消融方法带来的损失仍然显著。

paragraphs.en: Removing Replanning or the Residual Gate lowers OC by 2.7 percentage points each. These stages complete the recovery process by translating repaired state into a revised action and checking that action before execution. Their smaller effects complement the larger gains from premise verification and repair, indicating that the main recovery benefit comes from correcting the state on which the agent plans.
paragraphs.zh: 移除重新规划或残差门，各自会将 OC 降低 2.7 个百分点。 这些阶段通过将修复后的状态转化为修订后的行动，并在执行前检查该行动，从而完成恢复过程。 它们较小的影响与前提验证和修复带来的较大收益相互补充，表明恢复的主要益处来自对智能体规划所依据的状态进行修正。

sents.en: Removing Replanning or the Residual Gate lowers OC by 2.7 percentage points each.
sents.zh: 移除重新规划或残差门，各自会将 OC 降低 2.7 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ4. The ablations support StateWise’s integrated recovery pipeline: Attribution locates influential premises, Resolution and Typed Grounding establish applicable evidence, Persistent Repair preserves corrections, and Replanning and the Residual Gate turn repaired state into a checked action.
paragraphs.zh: RQ4 的答案。 消融研究支持 StateWise 的一体化恢复流程：归因定位有影响力的前提，解析与类型化基础确立适用的证据，持续修复保留修正结果，而重新规划与残差门则将修复后的状态转化为经过验证的动作。

sents.en: Answer to RQ4.
sents.zh: RQ4 的答案。

sents.en: The ablations support StateWise’s integrated recovery pipeline: Attribution locates influential premises, Resolution and Typed Grounding establish applicable evidence, Persistent Repair preserves corrections, and Replanning and the Residual Gate turn repaired state into a checked action.
sents.zh: 消融研究支持 StateWise 的一体化恢复流程：归因定位有影响力的前提，解析与类型化基础确立适用的证据，持续修复保留修正结果，而重新规划与残差门则将修复后的状态转化为经过验证的动作。

paragraphs.en: We examine whether a correction made by StateWise continues to support subsequent tasks using 32 four-task sequences. T1 can trigger repair, while T2–T4 test correction reuse. Between tasks, conversation and workspace state are reset under the boundary in Section 3 , with only the persistent store retained. Table 2 reports task outcomes and AFS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 32 个包含四个任务的序列，检验 StateWise 所做的修正是否仍能支持后续任务。 T1 可以触发修复，而 T2–T4 则用于测试修正的重复利用。 在任务之间，对话和工作区状态会根据第 3 节中的边界进行重置，仅保留持久化存储的数据。 表 2 报告了任务结果和 AFS。

sents.zh: 我们使用 32 个包含四个任务的序列，检验 StateWise 所做的修正是否仍能支持后续任务。

sents.en: T1 can trigger repair, while T2–T4 test correction reuse.
sents.zh: T1 可以触发修复，而 T2–T4 则用于测试修正的重复利用。

sents.en: Between tasks, conversation and workspace state are reset under the boundary in Section 3 , with only the persistent store retained.
sents.zh: 在任务之间，对话和工作区状态会根据第 3 节中的边界进行重置，仅保留持久化存储的数据。

sents.en: Table 2 reports task outcomes and AFS.
sents.zh: 表 2 报告了任务结果和 AFS。

paragraphs.en: Starting from erroneous memory, StateWise achieves 92.7% correct and safe completion across subsequent tasks and 90.6% AFS, reaching the level of the correct-memory reference, which achieves 91.7% and 87.5%, respectively. RR reaches 97.9%, showing that repaired records remain available to later planning even after transient context is cleared.
paragraphs.zh: 从错误记忆开始，StateWise 在后续任务中实现了 92.7% 的正确且安全的完成率以及 90.6% 的 AFS，达到了正确记忆参考模型的水平（分别为 91.7% 和 87.5%）。 RR 达到了 97.9%，表明即使临时上下文被清除后，修复后的记录仍然可供后续规划使用。

sents.en: Starting from erroneous memory, StateWise achieves 92.7% correct and safe completion across subsequent tasks and 90.6% AFS, reaching the level of the correct-memory reference, which achieves 91.7% and 87.5%, respectively.
sents.zh: 从错误记忆开始，StateWise 在后续任务中实现了 92.7% 的正确且安全的完成率以及 90.6% 的 AFS，达到了正确记忆参考模型的水平（分别为 91.7% 和 87.5%）。

sents.en: RR reaches 97.9%, showing that repaired records remain available to later planning even after transient context is cleared.
sents.zh: RR 达到了 97.9%，表明即使临时上下文被清除后，修复后的记录仍然可供后续规划使用。

paragraphs.en: The tested baselines do not explicitly preserve verified corrections for subsequent reuse. Their later-task completion rates remain at 1.0%–6.2%, with AFS no higher than 3.1%, offering little sustained improvement over corrupted memory.
paragraphs.zh: 所测试的基线方法并未明确保留已验证的修正结果以供后续复用。 它们在后续任务中的完成率仍保持在 1.0%–6.2% 之间，其中 AFS 最高不超过 3.1%，相较于受损记忆几乎没有持续性的提升。

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ5. Starting from erroneous memory, StateWise achieves 90.6% AFS and 92.7% correct and safe completion across subsequent tasks, reaching the performance level of the correct-memory reference. Persistent repair allows the benefit of an initial correction to carry forward across the evaluated task sequence.
paragraphs.zh: RQ5 的答案。 从错误记忆开始，StateWise 在后续任务中实现了 90.6% 的 AFS 和 92.7% 的正确且安全的完成率，达到了正确记忆参考模型的性能水平。 持续修复使得初始修正带来的优势能够延续到整个评估任务序列中。

sents.en: Answer to RQ5.
sents.zh: RQ5 的答案。

sents.en: Starting from erroneous memory, StateWise achieves 90.6% AFS and 92.7% correct and safe completion across subsequent tasks, reaching the performance level of the correct-memory reference.

paragraphs.en: We examine whether StateWise maintains its recovery performance on repositories, tool operations, and state types not encountered during development. After finalizing the recovery method on 40 development cases, we identify both seen and unseen configurations within the 150-case evaluation set and compare their respective recovery outcomes using consistent evaluation criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验了 StateWise 在开发过程中未接触过的仓库、工具操作和状态类型上是否仍能保持其恢复性能。 在 40 个开发案例中完成恢复方法的最终确定后，我们从包含 150 个案例的评估集中识别出已见和未见配置，并使用一致的评估标准比较了各自的恢复结果。

sents.en: We examine whether StateWise maintains its recovery performance on repositories, tool operations, and state types not encountered during development.
sents.zh: 我们检验了 StateWise 在开发过程中未接触过的仓库、工具操作和状态类型上是否仍能保持其恢复性能。

sents.en: After finalizing the recovery method on 40 development cases, we identify both seen and unseen configurations within the 150-case evaluation set and compare their respective recovery outcomes using consistent evaluation criteria.
sents.zh: 在 40 个开发案例中完成恢复方法的最终确定后，我们从包含 150 个案例的评估集中识别出已见和未见配置，并使用一致的评估标准比较了各自的恢复结果。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 summarizes the configuration differences and transfer results.
paragraphs.zh: 图 9 总结了配置差异和迁移结果。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation introduces 8 repositories, 2 tool operations, 6 semantic state types, and 54 state–action combinations not encountered during development. Each combination comprises a state key, tool operation, scope, and verifier source. Of the 150 cases, 106 contain unseen configurations, including new individual units.
paragraphs.zh: 该评估引入了 8 个仓库、2 种工具操作、6 种语义状态类型，以及开发过程中未出现过的 54 种状态–动作组合。 每种组合均包含一个状态键、一种工具操作、一个作用域和一个验证器来源。 在 150 个案例中，有 106 个包含未见过的新配置，包括新的独立单元。

sents.en: The evaluation introduces 8 repositories, 2 tool operations, 6 semantic state types, and 54 state–action combinations not encountered during development.
sents.zh: 该评估引入了 8 个仓库、2 种工具操作、6 种语义状态类型，以及开发过程中未出现过的 54 种状态–动作组合。

sents.en: Each combination comprises a state key, tool operation, scope, and verifier source.
sents.zh: 每种组合均包含一个状态键、一种工具操作、一个作用域和一个验证器来源。

sents.en: Of the 150 cases, 106 contain unseen configurations, including new individual units.
sents.zh: 在 150 个案例中，有 106 个包含未见过的新配置，包括新的独立单元。

paragraphs.en: On these 106 cases, StateWise achieves 93.4% OC and 92.6% AC, with zero UAR, compared with 93.2% OC on seen configurations. It also achieves 95.1% OC on cases involving new state types and 98.4% on those involving new repositories. These results indicate that recovery remains effective across the tested interface changes, allowing the same procedure to be reused through the corresponding interface contracts.
paragraphs.zh: 在这 106 个案例中，StateWise 实现了 93.4% 的 OC 和 92.6% 的 AC，且 UAR 为零，而其在已见配置上的 OC 为 93.2%。 它在涉及新状态类型的案例中也实现了 95.1% 的 OC，在涉及新存储库的案例中则达到了 98.4%。 这些结果表明，所测试的接口变更并未影响恢复的有效性，因此可以通过相应的接口合同重复使用相同的流程。

sents.en: On these 106 cases, StateWise achieves 93.4% OC and 92.6% AC, with zero UAR, compared with 93.2% OC on seen configurations.
sents.zh: 在这 106 个案例中，StateWise 实现了 93.4% 的 OC 和 92.6% 的 AC，且 UAR 为零，而其在已见配置上的 OC 为 93.2%。

sents.en: It also achieves 95.1% OC on cases involving new state types and 98.4% on those involving new repositories.
sents.zh: 它在涉及新状态类型的案例中也实现了 95.1% 的 OC，在涉及新存储库的案例中则达到了 98.4%。

sents.en: These results indicate that recovery remains effective across the tested interface changes, allowing the same procedure to be reused through the corresponding interface contracts.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，所测试的接口变更并未影响恢复的有效性，因此可以通过相应的接口合同重复使用相同的流程。

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ6. StateWise achieves 93.4% OC and 92.6% AC on unseen configurations, with zero UAR and OC comparable to that on seen configurations. These results support reuse across the tested repositories, tool operations, and state types through supplied interface contracts, without modifying the core recovery procedure.
paragraphs.zh: RQ6 的答案。 StateWise 在未见的配置上实现了 93.4% 的 OC 和 92.6% 的 AC，且 UAR 为零，其 OC 与在已见配置上的表现相当。 这些结果表明，通过所提供的接口契约，可以在所测试的代码库、工具操作和状态类型之间重复使用该方法，而无需修改核心恢复流程。

sents.en: Answer to RQ6.
sents.zh: RQ6 的答案。

sents.en: StateWise achieves 93.4% OC and 92.6% AC on unseen configurations, with zero UAR and OC comparable to that on seen configurations.
sents.zh: StateWise 在未见的配置上实现了 93.4% 的 OC 和 92.6% 的 AC，且 UAR 为零，其 OC 与在已见配置上的表现相当。

sents.en: These results support reuse across the tested repositories, tool operations, and state types through supplied interface contracts, without modifying the core recovery procedure.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，通过所提供的接口契约，可以在所测试的代码库、工具操作和状态类型之间重复使用该方法，而无需修改核心恢复流程。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation results motivate treating persistent-state recovery as part of reliable agent execution. We discuss how its benefits extend across successive tasks, how StateWise connects record-level action dependence with evidence-supported persistent updates, and how verification and scope requirements shape its practical applicability.
paragraphs.zh: 评估结果表明，将持久状态恢复视为可靠智能体执行的一部分是合理的。 我们探讨了其益处如何延续到连续任务中，StateWise 如何将记录级别的行动依赖性与有证据支持的持久更新相连接，以及验证和范围要求如何影响其实用性。

paragraphs.en: Connecting Actions, Evidence, and Persistent Updates. StateWise’s technical contribution is the correspondence it maintains among an action’s supporting records, evidence of their current validity, and scoped persistent corrections. Constrained counterfactual replanning provides evidence of decision dependence, making the proposed action a focused target for state diagnosis. The record’s type and authority then determine how its validity is resolved, and typed evidence grounding binds the resulting correction to the same record and its established scope. This binding specifies which active value is superseded and which unrelated records must remain unchanged. Persistent writeback retains this correction and its lineage for current replanning and later retrieval. This connection turns action-triggered verification into reusable state maintenance. An independent state–action check assesses the revised operation against the verified state and execution constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 连接动作、证据与持久更新。 StateWise 的技术贡献在于它维护了动作的支持记录、其当前有效性的证据以及限定范围内的持久性修正之间的对应关系。 受限的反事实重新规划提供了决策依赖性的证据，使所提议的动作成为状态诊断的明确目标。 随后，记录的类型和权限将决定其有效性如何得到解决，而类型化的证据基础则会将产生的修正绑定到同一记录及其既定范围中。 这种绑定明确了哪个活跃值会被取代，以及哪些无关记录必须保持不变。 持久性回写会保留此修正及其来源信息，以供当前的重新规划和后续检索使用。 这种关联将动作触发的验证转化为可重用的状态维护机制。 独立的状态-动作检查会将修订后的操作与已验证的状态及执行约束进行比对评估。

The transfer results support extending this structure through supplied interface contracts and corresponding verifier adapters.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we studied how invalid persistent operational records influence coding-agent decisions and proposed StateWise for pre-action diagnosis and recovery. The framework connects action attribution, current-validity verification, and scoped persistent repair with replanning and independent action checks, preserving confirmed corrections for later tasks. On the primary 150-case benchmark, StateWise achieves 93.3% overall correctness under corrupted persistent state, compared with 38.7% for the baseline, with no unsafe actions observed. This work addresses a gap between intervening in the current action and correcting the persistent premise that guides subsequent decisions. An invalid record can survive a blocked operation or a locally corrected decision and continue to influence later plans. StateWise makes the corresponding record and its applicable scope explicit targets of evidence-supported recovery. These findings connect agent-memory research with planning and action safety through the validity of operational premises. They motivate evaluating operational memory through its current applicability, influence on actions, and reuse of verified corrections, and integrating state maintenance into the execution architecture of agents operating across tasks and changing environments.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了无效的持久性操作记录如何影响编码智能体的决策，并提出了 StateWise 用于行动前的诊断与恢复。 该框架将行动归因、当前有效性验证和范围限定下的持久性修复与重新规划及独立行动检查相连接，同时保留已确认的修正结果供后续任务使用。 在包含 150 个案例的主要基准测试中，面对被破坏的持久状态时，StateWise 的整体正确率达到了 93.3%，而基线模型仅为 38.7%，且未观察到任何不安全行动。 这项工作填补了干预当前行动与修正指导后续决策的持久性前提之间的空白。 一条无效记录可能在操作受阻或决策被局部修正后仍然存在，并继续影响后续计划。 StateWise 将相应的记录及其适用范围明确作为由证据支持的恢复目标。 这些发现通过操作前提的有效性，将智能体记忆研究与规划及行动安全性联系了起来。 这些结果促使我们通过评估操作记忆的当前适用性、其对行动的影响以及已验证修正的重复使用，并将状态维护整合到跨任务、跨变化环境运行的智能体的执行架构中。
